commands.result_summary:
# CLI Conventions (authoring)

This reference covers the **authoring-side** CLI surface only: the read-only
registry discovery commands used to produce a valid, importable Maestro `.bpmn`
file. The registry commands below never mutate cloud state. Operate and diagnose
use different CLI commands — see
[operate/CAPABILITY.md](operate/CAPABILITY.md) and
[diagnose/CAPABILITY.md](diagnose/CAPABILITY.md).

## Discovery commands (read-only, authoring-safe)

All commands below are discovery/read-only. None mutate cloud state.

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `uip maestro bpmn registry pull [-f\|--force]` | Sync and cache the registry. Without login, only OOTB extension types are synced; login adds discovered connectors and processes. |
| `uip maestro bpmn registry list [--limit <n\|-1>]` | List cached extension types (and discovered connectors/processes). Default 30; use `--limit -1` for all. |
| `uip maestro bpmn registry search <keyword>` | Find entries by keyword across extension type, label, connector name, process name. |
| `uip maestro bpmn registry get <extensionType> [--connection-id <id>] [--object-name <name>]` | Get the full spec for one extension type: `xmlTemplate`, `contextFields`, `bindingInfo`, input/output patterns. `--connection-id`/`--object-name` add live Integration Service field metadata for `Intsvc.*` connector types. |
| `uip is connections list --all-folders` | List live Integration Service connections (id + state) across all folders. Always pass `--all-folders`; a folder-scoped list silently misses connections. |

These are the registry/discovery commands the skill verifies against the CLI
source (`packages/maestro-tool/src/commands/registry.ts`). Do not invent flags.
Validation uses `uip maestro bpmn validate <file>` — see
[Validation](structural-bpmn.md#validation).

The `validate` command runs the full PO.Frontend canvas rule set offline (it was
added to the CLI in UiPath/cli#3135). If your CLI reports `validate` as an
unknown command, or it clearly runs only the deploy-readiness checks and not the
structural rules, the installed CLI predates that change — update to the latest:

```bash
npm install -g @uipath/cli@latest   # or: bun add -g @uipath/cli
```

> **Don't conclude "it doesn't exist" from truncated discovery output.** A row past a cutoff reads exactly like a missing row. Two cutoffs bite here: `registry list` defaults to **30** — pass `--limit -1` for the full set — and piping `registry search`/`is connections list` through `head`/`tail`/`grep -m`/a pager drops everything past the cap. To check existence, narrow the query (keyword to `registry search`, `--all-folders` to connection lists) rather than capping rows; cap only data already known complete.

## Output parsing

Whenever a CLI result is parsed programmatically, pass `--output json`. If a
command does not support JSON, do not silently scrape human text; keep the step
manual and tell the user.

## Login boundary

Local source authoring and `uip maestro bpmn validate` work without login (the
validator runs fully offline). Registry
discovery of **connectors and processes** (and Integration Service field
enrichment) requires `uip login`. Without login, `registry pull` still returns
the built-in (OOTB) extension types.

## Never fabricate an identifier

Connection IDs, `releaseKey`/process keys, queue keys, connector keys, app IDs,
folder IDs/paths — every concrete identifier comes from discovery
(`registry get`, `registry search`, `uip is connections list`) or from the user.
Never invent one. When a required identifier is unknown, leave the placeholder
in place, flag it as a draft binding, and ask the user.

commands.result_summary:
150	## Script tasks (`BPMN.ScriptTask`) — Jint runtime contract
151	
152	`bpmn:scriptTask scriptFormat="JavaScript"` runs under **Jint**, not Node.js or
153	a browser. The mapping payload comes from the `BPMN.ScriptTask` registry
154	template, but the runtime contract is fixed:
155	
156	- Only these helpers exist: `uipath.aggregate`, `uipath._aggregate`,
157	  `uipath._pipe`, and a no-op `console`. No npm packages, filesystem, network,
158	  browser globals, or long-running async behavior. Execution envelope is ~64 MB
159	  / 30 s.
160	- Set `uipath:scriptVersion value="v3"` for new scripts; preserve an imported
161	  `value="v2"`. For v2+ the script returns JSON under `response`.
162	- Mapped `args` fields are read as **top-level identifiers** in the script body
163	  (`amount`, not `args.amount`); the input mapping itself stays `name="args"`
164	  with `type="json"` and `target="bodyField"`, and maps each field by variable
165	  id (`=vars.Var_Amount`). Include `<uipath:input name="args" type="json"
166	  target="bodyField"><![CDATA[{}]]></uipath:input>` even when there are no
167	  inputs; this is part of the `BPMN.ScriptTask` registry template.
168	- Map the returned object's property back through `source="=result.response"`
169	  (the conventional scalar property) or `source="=result.response.<field>"`
170	  (another object field); `var` points at a declared variable id (do not put the
171	  target id in `name`).
172	- When the output mapping uses `source="=result.response"`, return an object
173	  with a `response` property, such as `return { response: 6 * 7 };`. Do not
174	  return the bare primitive `42` for that mapping shape; there is no
175	  `response` property to bind, so the runtime variable stays empty.
176	- Do not use `source="=result"` with a bare scalar return in live debug/runtime
177	  BPMN. Studio Web can report `FinalStatus: Completed` while the target root
178	  variable still reads back as `{}` or `null` from
179	  `debug-instance variables-all`.
180	- For live debug/runtime runs, never use `source="=this.result"` or
181	  `<uipath:type value="BPMN.Variables" ...>` on a script task output mapping.
182	  That older structural-test shape can pass local validation but leaves root
183	  variables `null` or faults in Studio Web. Use the `BPMN.ScriptTask` mapping
184	  with `source="=result.response"`.
185	- Do not mutate `Globals.*`, `vars.*`, or process variables inside the script
186	  body. The supported path is: return a value from the script, then use a
187	  `uipath:output` mapping to write it to the declared variable. Direct mutation
188	  is not applied to the runtime, so the variable reads empty afterward.
189	
190	```xml
191	<bpmn:scriptTask id="Task_RiskScore" name="Risk Score" scriptFormat="JavaScript">
192	  <bpmn:extensionElements>
193	    <uipath:scriptVersion value="v3" />
194	    <uipath:mapping version="v1">
195	      <uipath:type value="BPMN.ScriptTask" version="v1" />
196	      <uipath:input name="args" type="json" target="bodyField"><![CDATA[{"amount":"=vars.Var_Amount","daysOverdue":"=vars.Var_DaysOverdue"}]]></uipath:input>
197	      <uipath:output name="riskScore" type="number" var="Var_RiskScore" source="=result.response" />
198	    </uipath:mapping>
199	  </bpmn:extensionElements>
200	  <bpmn:script><![CDATA[
201	var score = amount * 0.01 + daysOverdue * 2;
202	return { response: score };
203	]]></bpmn:script>
204	</bpmn:scriptTask>
205	```
206

208	
209	The registry never emits `<bpmn:sequenceFlow>`, conditions, or the gateway

content_blocks.text:
Validation surfaced 2 pre-existing errors on the `args` input mapping (`must declare type="json"` / `must target "bodyField"`) — I confirmed these are **not caused by my edit**: running the same CLI validator against an unmodified copy of the original file produces the identical 2 errors. Since the task requires existing `uipath:*` extension payloads to round-trip untouched, I did not touch that `args` input tag (fixing it would mean rewriting a payload I was told to preserve).

Here's the diff of what I actually changed:

The edit is complete and surgical — three lines changed, nothing else touched:

1. **New process variable** `Var_Tax` (name `"Tax"`, type `number`) added to the `BPMN.Variables` block, right after the existing `Var_Total`.
2. **New output mapping** `<uipath:output name="tax" type="number" var="Var_Tax" source="=result.response.tax" />` added alongside the existing `total` output in `Task_Calc`'s `uipath:mapping`.
3. **Script body** now also returns `tax: amount * 0.2` in the `response` object, following the `BPMN.ScriptTask` Jint contract (return via `response.<field>`, mapped back by `source="=result.response.tax"`).

Everything else — `Var_Amount`, `Var_Total`, the `total` output, all element ids, `uipath:migrationVersion version="11.5"`, the `uipath:caseManagement` CDATA payload, the diagram, and flows — is byte-identical to the original.

**Validation:** `uip maestro bpmn validate Invoicing.bpmn --output json` reports 2 errors on the `args` input tag (`must declare type="json"`, `must target "bodyField"`). I verified these are pre-existing: running the identical validator against an untouched copy of the original file produces the exact same 2 errors. Since fixing them would require rewriting the `uipath:input name="args"` payload — which you asked to preserve untouched as an existing extension payload — I left it as-is. No new validation errors were introduced by this change.

The edit is complete and surgical — three lines changed, nothing else touched:

1. **New process variable** `Var_Tax` (name `"Tax"`, type `number`) added to the `BPMN.Variables` block, right after the existing `Var_Total`.
2. **New output mapping** `<uipath:output name="tax" type="number" var="Var_Tax" source="=result.response.tax" />` added alongside the existing `total` output in `Task_Calc`'s `uipath:mapping`.
3. **Script body** now also returns `tax: amount * 0.2` in the `response` object, following the `BPMN.ScriptTask` Jint contract (return via `response.<field>`, mapped back by `source="=result.response.tax"`).

Everything else — `Var_Amount`, `Var_Total`, the `total` output, all element ids, `uipath:migrationVersion version="11.5"`, the `uipath:caseManagement` CDATA payload, the diagram, and flows — is byte-identical to the original.

**Validation:** `uip maestro bpmn validate Invoicing.bpmn --output json` reports 2 errors on the `args` input tag (`must declare type="json"`, `must target "bodyField"`). I verified these are pre-existing: running the identical validator against an untouched copy of the original file produces the exact same 2 errors. Since fixing them would require rewriting the `uipath:input name="args"` payload — which you asked to preserve untouched as an existing extension payload — I left it as-is. No new validation errors were introduced by this change.

resolved.initial_prompt:
Load and follow the uipath-maestro-bpmn skill.

A valid Maestro BPMN file `Invoicing.bpmn` is in the working directory. The
"Calculate Total" (Task_Calc) script task returns a total and maps it to the
Total variable.

Add a SECOND output named "tax" to "Calculate Total": have the script also
return a tax value, map that output to a NEW process variable you declare in
the BPMN.Variables block, and have the script populate it.

Make a SURGICAL edit: the existing "total" output, the existing variables, all
element ids, the uipath:* extension payloads, and uipath:migrationVersion must
round-trip untouched.

Validate the edited file locally before finishing. Do not upload, publish,
deploy, debug, run, or pack anything, and do not pause for approval — make the
edit end to end in one pass.

description: >

  Maestro BPMN and declare the backing variable in BPMN.Variables, without
  disturbing the existing output, variables, or preserve-only payloads.
tags: [uipath-maestro-bpmn, integration, "mode:build", "lifecycle:generate", "shape:multi-node"]

run_limits:
  expected_turns: 16
  max_turns: 70

sandbox:
  template_sources:
    - type: template_dir
      path: ../../../../../skills/uipath-maestro-bpmn
    - type: template_dir
      path: fixture

initial_prompt: |
  Load and follow the uipath-maestro-bpmn skill.

  A valid Maestro BPMN file `Invoicing.bpmn` is in the working directory. The
  "Calculate Total" (Task_Calc) script task returns a total and maps it to the
  Total variable.

  Add a SECOND output named "tax" to "Calculate Total": have the script also
  return a tax value, map that output to a NEW process variable you declare in
  the BPMN.Variables block, and have the script populate it.

  Make a SURGICAL edit: the existing "total" output, the existing variables, all
  element ids, the uipath:* extension payloads, and uipath:migrationVersion must
  round-trip untouched.

  Validate the edited file locally before finishing. Do not upload, publish,
  deploy, debug, run, or pack anything, and do not pause for approval — make the
  edit end to end in one pass.

success_criteria:
  - type: file_exists
    description: "The edited BPMN file is still present"
    path: "Invoicing.bpmn"
    weight: 1.0
    pass_threshold: 1.0

  - type: file_contains
    description: "Preserve-only payload round-tripped untouched"
    path: "Invoicing.bpmn"
    includes:
      - "preserve-only-do-not-touch"
      - 'uipath:migrationVersion'
    weight: 1.0
    pass_threshold: 1.0

  - type: run_command
    description: "New output + backing variable added, existing output/variables preserved, file still structurally sound"
    command: "python3 $TASK_DIR/check_add_output.py"
    timeout: 30
    expected_exit_code: 0
    weight: 4.0
    pass_threshold: 1.0

cd /tmp && cat > Invoicing_orig.bpmn << 'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions
    xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
    xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
    xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
    xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
    xmlns:uipath="http://uipath.org/schema/bpmn"
    id="Definitions_Invoicing" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn"
    exporter="UiPath (https://bpmn.uipath.com)" exporterVersion="1.0">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Invoicing" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:extensionElements>
      <uipath:migrationVersion version="11.5" />
      <uipath:caseManagement version="v1"><![CDATA[{"owner":"billing","opaque":"preserve-only-do-not-touch"}]]></uipath:caseManagement>
      <uipath:variables version="v1">
        <uipath:inputOutput id="Var_Amount" name="Amount" type="number" />
        <uipath:inputOutput id="Var_Total" name="Total" type="number" />
      </uipath:variables>
    </bpmn:extensionElements>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_1" name="Start"><bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SC</bpmn:outgoing></bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:scriptTask id="Task_Calc" name="Calculate Total" scriptFormat="JavaScript">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <uipath:scriptVersion value="v3" />

          <uipath:type value="BPMN.ScriptTask" version="v1" />
          <uipath:input name="args"><![CDATA[{"amount":"=vars.Var_Amount"}]]></uipath:input>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_1" name="Done"><bpmn:incoming>Flow_CE</bpmn:incoming></bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SC" sourceRef="Start_1" targetRef="Task_Calc" />

      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="E_Flow_CE" bpmnElement="Flow_CE"><di:waypoint x="350" y="118" /><di:waypoint x="410" y="118" /></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
EOF
